thread:
arjun: quick heads-up — ran pprof on ingress host during the 11:34 spike. tokenize+parse path is ~3x slower on small requests compared to yesterday. looks host-side, not GPU.

maria: link to the profile? graph? :eyes:

arjun: https://grafana.internal/redwood/runtime/ingress?panel=parse_cpu

arjun: copying the top lines from pprof (short window):
```
pprof: top 10
45.1%  parse_request
18.2%  syscall_writev
12.3%  malloc
9.0%   spin_lock_contended
6.0%   tokenizer.tokenize
```

devon: interesting — spin_lock_contended that high suggests more contention in the host parsing pipeline. did anything touch the kernel or pthreads last week?

infra-bot: deploy-bot: rolled kernel-6.4.1 to staging nodes on 2025-03-12 11:20 UTC for host-sched fixes.

ken: kv-cache hit rates during the spike? if KV misses spike we reparse more and hit malloc/writev a lot.

arjun: kvcache hit rate dropped from 98% -> 86% in the same window. suspect batching heuristic change in last deploy that created more tiny batches -> higher miss churn.

maria: tiny batches are bad for both kvcache locality and spin contention. can we force an adaptive micro-batch: if seq_len < 32 and concurrent < 12, group to batch=8?

devon: we also saw an allocator regression in the tokenizer shim: a recent change converted some slices to new strings, causing extra mallocs+memcpys. patch in PR #421 should be reverted or switched to zero-copy view.

arjun: plan: 1) revert tokenizer allocation change on staging 2) apply adaptive micro-batch rule as config override 3) run canary at 10% for 30m and reprofile. I'll kick off.

ken: also check grpc vs http2 path — writev cost looks high. grpc pooling might be disabled for small streams after the protocol shim.

arjun: noted. i'll enable pooled writev path in staging to compare.

maria: if that fixes, push a small telemetry metric: host_parse_lock_wait_us and kvcache_locality_ratio. will help catch regressions automatically.

devon: 👍 also add a quick flamegraph to the nightly perf job for ingress-host so we can see regressions earlier.

arjun: starting canary now. will post results in ~40m. thanks all :thumbsup:
